# R5.28 — One supported native recipe and exact CLI forwarding

## Summary

Lands the §2.1/§7.1 **one supported native recipe and exact CLI
forwarding** rows (ADR-0406). `crates/hharness/src/recipe.rs` is
`hh-recipe/1` — the one versioned in-process recipe above the
landed owners: `run_recipe(&mut EmbedService, &RecipePlan) →
Result<RecipeReceipt, RecipeError>` drives binding (a)'s
`EmbedService::handle` through `hello` →
`lab.experiment.{register, expand, open_experiment}` → bounded
`next`/`claim`/`launch` drain → `adopt_subject` (the durable
`launch_binding` re-folded through `ExperimentView::fold`, the
launch's own `subject_writer` re-presented) → `submit` on the
scripted `EmbedModel` lane → the durable evidence gate
(`lifecycle.run.finished` + an observed `hh.submit` submission
ref — a process-only success never grades) → the declared grade
committed `measurement.metric.emitted` through
`surface_commit_row` under the persisted writer generation →
`settle` → `close` → `ResultsStore::project_and_record` →
`lab.analysis.analyze` (`rows[]` derived from the projected key
ids) → `drain_notifications` verbatim or
`n/a{no_callback_channels}` → `assemble_receipt` over an
actual-fact `DeclaredReceipt`. The `RecipePlan` is inputs-only:
authored record members refuse `unsupported_shape`, missing
members `missing_field`, wrong types `type_mismatch`; every
coordinate on the receipt derives from durable facts — no second
runner/store/codec, no forged rows, no `hharness → hharness-cli`
edge.

The K-2 CLI repair makes the selected `hh` wrappers forward what
the boundary requires, verbatim: `experiment` ops now carry
`run_plan_id` (`--plan`), `lease_id` (`--lease`), `holder`,
`subject_holder`, `bundle_id`, `reason`, `probe`, and
`partial: true` (absent flags stay absent — the boundary owns
required-member refusal); `compare report <params-file>` sends
the canonical `lab.analysis.analyze` body then
`render{report_id, view:"report"}`; `compare scorecard
<report-id>` sends `render{report_id, view:"scorecard"}`. The
`{baseline,candidate}` and `{view, experiment_id}` wrapper
shapes — unsupported inventions the boundary could only refuse —
are removed (the §9.3 existing-contract-fix class, same as
M1/R5.10 and R0/R5.24).

## What changed

- `crates/hharness/src/recipe.rs` — `hh-recipe/1`: `RecipePlan`
  closed-member decode, `RecipeError` closed sum
  (`Refused`/`Boundary`/`Owner`, seven refusal codes),
  `run_recipe`, `RecipeReceipt`/`SlotRecord` + canonical
  `to_json`.
- `crates/hharness/src/lib.rs` — `pub mod recipe;` (the facade is
  the composition layer; every owner dependency already present —
  no new crate edge).
- `crates/hh-cli/src/lab.rs` — `cmd_experiment_op` member
  forwarding table; `cmd_compare_report`/`cmd_compare_scorecard`
  on real `report_id`/params-file shapes.
- `crates/hh-cli/src/cli.rs` — `VALUE_FLAGS +=
  plan/lease/subject-holder/bundle-id/probe`; `SWITCHES +=
  partial`.
- `crates/hharness/tests/r5_28.rs` — 5-case scratch-store battery;
  `crates/hh-cli/tests/in_process.rs` — 2 boundary-shape
  regressions + the s31 routing test updated to the params-file
  shape.
- ADR-0406 (landing record), coverage dated note (seq 198), BL-47
  home + index/revisit triggers regenerated (190 ADRs), run
  ledger.

## Deviation (conspicuous)

**2,005 changed source/test lines vs the ≤850 trigger (~2.4×)**
— recorded Deviation, accepted per the scoped AMEND ruling
`6ff01462` (`docs/build/planning/2026-11-03_R5.28-split-review.md`):
decomposition row 32 binds recipe + CLI fields as one owner row
with no contingency; K-2 forwarding is an existing-contract fix
(same class as M1/R5.10, R0/R5.24); the recipe↔CLI seam is real
but undocumented — the recipe bypasses the CLI path entirely and
fails the documentary test (R5.26 precedent); leg (b) ~1,723
alone still ~2× over — non-curative; AC-1's conjunctive
end-to-end predicate spans the cut.
